cases.name: organization_count
cases.question: Bazada jami nechta tashkilot bor?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM organization

cases.name: authorized_warehouse_count
cases.question: Bazada nechta vakolatli ombor bor?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.id) AS total FROM public.region r JOIN public.district d ON d.region_id = r.id JOIN public.warehouse w ON w.district_id = d.id WHERE COALESCE(w.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE AND w.working_factory_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(w.name, '') NOT ILIKE '%Chiqim Ombor%' AND COALESCE(w.name, '') NOT ILIKE '%Qoldiq%'

cases.name: qashqadaryo_authorized_warehouse_count
cases.question: Qashqadartoda nechta vakolatli ombor?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.id) AS total FROM public.region r JOIN public.district d ON d.region_id = r.id JOIN public.warehouse w ON w.district_id = d.id WHERE r.name_uz = 'Qashqadaryo viloyati' AND COALESCE(w.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE AND w.working_factory_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(w.name, '') NOT ILIKE '%Chiqim Ombor%' AND COALESCE(w.name, '') NOT ILIKE '%Qoldiq%'

cases.name: authorized_warehouse_count_by_region
cases.question: har bitta viloyatda vakolatli omborlar nechta?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT r.name_uz AS viloyat, COUNT(DISTINCT w.id) AS ombor_soni FROM public.region r JOIN public.district d ON d.region_id = r.id JOIN public.warehouse w ON w.district_id = d.id WHERE COALESCE(w.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE AND w.working_factory_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(w.name, '') NOT ILIKE '%Chiqim Ombor%' AND COALESCE(w.name, '') NOT ILIKE '%Qoldiq%' GROUP BY r.id, r.name_uz ORDER BY ombor_soni DESC, viloyat

cases.name: navoiyazot_latest_debtor_balance
cases.question: Navoiyazotning eng so'nggi debitor qarzi qancha?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.amount), 0) AS total FROM debtor_creditor1c d LEFT JOIN organization o ON d.organization_id = o.id WHERE d.date_created = (SELECT MAX(date_created) FROM debtor_creditor1c) AND d.type = 'debitor' AND o.name ILIKE '%Navoiyazot%'

cases.name: top_five_sold_products
cases.question: Eng ko'p sotilgan top 5 ta mahsulot qaysilar?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(COALESCE(real_quantity, quantity)) AS total_quantity FROM sold_lot WHERE product_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, product_name ASC LIMIT 5

cases.name: investment_count
cases.question: Jami investitsiya loyihalari nechta?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM investment

cases.name: actual_sales_revenue
cases.question: Amaldagi jami sotuv tushumi qancha?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(revenue), 0) AS total_revenue FROM finmodel_sales_actual_monthly

cases.name: latest_stock_top_ten
cases.question: Eng so'nggi sana bo'yicha ombor qoldig'i eng ko'p top 10 ta mahsulot qaysilar?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(p.name_uz, p.mxik_name) AS product_name, COALESCE(SUM(w.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity FROM warehouse_daily_amount w LEFT JOIN product p ON w.product_id = p.id WHERE w.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM warehouse_daily_amount) AND COALESCE(p.name_uz, p.mxik_name) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(p.name_uz, p.mxik_name) ORDER BY total_quantity DESC NULLS LAST, product_name ASC LIMIT 10

cases.name: personnel_count
cases.question: Xodimlar jadvalida jami nechta yozuv bor?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM personal_check
